title: gemini-notebook-code-artifact
$comment: A source-grounded code proposal produced by the Gemini Notebook inference provider and carried as JSON. This is an authored proposal, not an assay, release, credential grant, repository mutation, or activation. A receiving settlement must independently validate, test, and admit any file before writing it into its territory.

assayRequired.$comment: The provider is the author. This constant prevents its carrier from being mistaken for verification or receiving-settlement release.
